subject: ApexCloud - retention addendum request and SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@apexcloud.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: security@apexcloud.com, procurement@apexcloud.com
Date: 2028-04-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: extended retention & auditor evidence (ApexCloud)

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ApexCloud is excited about Redwood's inference performance. Our security and compliance team is reviewing the integration and we've hit one area that will need an exception or an addendum in the contract.

Ask in short: our regulators require retention of request/transaction audit logs for 12 months for a subset of tenant activity tied to payments. Redwood's default operational retention for raw request traces is 30 days. Can Redwood support a customer-specific retention carveout (12 months) for:
- inference request metadata (timestamps, model id, token counts)
- request/response hashed identifiers (no PII)
- operational audit trails (access logs for the tenant)

We are happy to accept redaction and controlled access to the longer-retained artifacts. Attached is ApexCloud's retention exception form with the required fields filled (apexc-ma-request-0418.pdf).

Additionally, our SOC 2 auditors will want: a proof-of-delete process, a certificate of deletion when retention expires, and any supporting CAIQ/SIG mapping you can share. Please let us know if this is feasible, an estimated timeline for configuration, and whether there are additional commercial terms.

Thanks,
Lina Gomez
Security Program Manager | ApexCloud
lina.gomez@apexcloud.com

----
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@apexcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-20T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended retention & auditor evidence (ApexCloud)

Lina — thanks for the clear ask and the form. Looping in Neha (security) and Rishi (legal) to scope technical and contractual feasibility.

A few clarifying questions so we scope the right approach:
1) Scope: can you confirm which tenants/environments this applies to? (prod tenant ID(s) or account IDs)
2) Data types: please confirm whether payloads contain customer PII. You mentioned hashed identifiers — we need to confirm PII is not stored in the longer-lived artifacts.
3) Retention gradient: do you need full raw request/response pairs for 12 months, or is a redacted/aggregated index acceptable for audits?
4) Access & export: will ApexCloud require regular exports (e.g., quarterly) or just on-demand for audits?

High-level options we can support:
- Customer-scoped S3-backed retention with RBAC and customer-managed KMS (recommended) — retains artifacts for 12 months, redacted by default, access only via support-approved export.
- Pseudonymized index (retain metadata + hash pointers) for 12 months; raw payloads pruned after 30 days. Lower cost and still audit-friendly.

We have a short retention policy summary I can attach; that should help auditors. Separately, any addendum will need a legal sign-off — Rishi, can you advise on typical language for a retention addendum and whether we should offer a fee for custom retention?

Proposed next step: Neha/Marissa and I will put a technical proposal together by EOD Apr 24 and share a draft addendum for signature. Are you available for a short call on Apr 25 to walk through options?

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

----
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@apexcloud.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-21T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: extended retention & auditor evidence (ApexCloud)

Hi all — technical background and a proposed control set.

1) Retention categories we maintain today (short):
- Ephemeral inference traces (raw request/response): default 30d (can be extended per-tenant to S3-storage)
- Access/audit logs (auth/authz events): 90d by default; retained longer if requested
- Aggregated metrics/telemetry: 24 months

2) Options to meet 12-month ask while minimizing risk:
A) Customer-managed KMS + encrypted S3 with lifecycle rule -> 12 months, automatic delete + provided deletion certificate. Access limited to support+customer by IAM + VPC endpoint.
B) Redaction pipeline: strip request bodies and retain only non-PII metadata + hashed identifiers for 12 months (raw bodies deleted after 30d). Meets many auditor asks and reduces exposure.
C) Snapshot & escrow: for customers with heavy audit needs we can produce periodic snapshots delivered to a customer-controlled escrow (S3 bucket) and then delete from our environment.

3) Evidence we can provide for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ:
- SOC 2: control descriptions for retention & disposition, logs of deletion jobs, and periodic attestation from Redwood for the period (our SOC 2 report still covers the platform; addendum will clarify exception).
- SIG: we can map the change to SIG rows around data lifecycle; we'll produce a short mapping doc (example: SIG row 3.2 data_retention -> shows configuration & KMS).
- CAIQ/CCM: we can cite CCM A.8 / A.12-like controls and provide artifact IDs (audit-log-YYYYMMDD) and sample proof-of-delete records.

4) Implementation & ETA:
- If Apex accepts A or B above, expected ETA is ~10 business days for config + testing (we'll need a short-lived test export and one round of validation).
- If escrow delivery required, add 3-5 business days.

I'll prepare a 1-page technical appendix and a sample proof-of-delete CSV by Apr 24.

- Neha Kapoor
Sr. InfoSec Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

----
From: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@apexcloud.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@apexcloud.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-24T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended retention & auditor evidence (ApexCloud)

Thanks Neha and team — this is very helpful. A few follow-ups from our side so we can present to our auditors next week:

1) Proof-of-delete: auditors want an automated certificate for each deletion job with a hash of the deleted object, timestamp, job run-id, and who triggered it. Can Redwood produce that as a signed artifact?
2) Auditability window: if we accept redaction (B), can you provide an example of the redacted artifact and a mapping file so auditors can see how to reconstruct events?
3) Cost: please confirm if the customer-managed KMS + 12mo S3 will incur a monthly add-on, and ballpark the estimated incremental charge.

We are fine with scoping the exception to a single prod tenant and to metadata/redacted traces only. If Redwood can provide the proof-of-delete artifact + mapping and a short addendum we can sign, we should be able to get procurement moving.

Happy to take the call Apr 25 — if you can send a calendar invite.

Best,
Michael O'Neill
Head of Procurement | ApexCloud
m.oneill@apexcloud.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@apexcloud.com>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@apexcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-26T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended retention & auditor evidence (ApexCloud)

Michael / Lina — thanks for the clarifications. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of agreed approach (proposed):
- Scope: single prod tenant (ApexCloud account ID: AC-99123)
- Data retained for 12 months: redacted inference metadata + hashed identifiers only (no raw request/response bodies)
- Controls: customer-managed KMS, encrypted S3 with lifecycle rule, VPC-only access, and access logging (audit trail) retained for 24 months
- Proof-of-delete: Redwood will produce a signed deletion certificate (CSV + PGP signature) listing object-hash, timestamp, job-id, and operator-id for scheduled deletions. Sample will be provided.
- Evidence pack for auditors: rightsized SOC 2 control mapping + SIG/CAIQ mapping excerpt and sample proof-of-delete.
- ETA: 10 business days for config + 2 business days for sample validation (we'll build and test in a staging subaccount).
- Commercials: there is a $1,200/month premium for the custom retention add-on (covers storage + additional controls). Rishi will draft the addendum language; once signed we will schedule implementation.

Deliverables we will produce by Apr 30: draft addendum (docx), technical appendix (1 page), sample proof-of-delete (CSV + PGP sig), and a cost estimate worksheet.

Action items:
- Rishi (legal) to circulate draft addendum by Apr 28.
- Neha to send the technical appendix + sample proof-of-delete by Apr 30.
- Marissa to add this to the HS-32145 HubSpot deal and update SOW lines.
- Michael & Lina: confirm AC-99123 is the correct tenant and whether you'll accept the $1,200/mo premium.

I'll schedule a 30-min call for Apr 25/26 so we can align — invite sent. If that time doesn't work, let me know alternatives.

Thanks — look forward to getting this over the finish line.

— Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
